versions.statement: Notion将多种工作流程整合到一体化工作空间中，提供可从数十个构建块自定义的工作区。

value.strengths: blending much of your workflow into an all-in-one workspace; customize your own workspace from dozens of building blocks
value.opportunities: break away from today's tools—and bring back some of the ideas of those early pioneers

versions.statement: Notion是一款功能丰富的协作型知识管理工具，具有高度可定制化、内置数据库、协作工具等优势，但存在复杂性高、缺乏离线访问、性能缓慢等问题。

strengths: Great tools for importing from Evernote (and other apps)
Customize your own workspace from dozens of building blocks
opportunities: Breaking away from today's tools—bring back some of the ideas of those early pioneers
Blending much of your workflow into an all-in-one workspace
threats: Complex interface may alienate non-technical users
Performance issues (sluggish) could reduce user adoption
Feature gaps compared to specialized tools

versions.statement: Notion是一个全能型工作空间，提供无限存储和跨平台支持，但存在复杂性、缺乏离线访问和性能问题等弱点，同时面临复杂性和性能障碍的威胁，但也拥有打破传统工具局限和导入Evernote等应用的机会。

strengths: Great tools for importing from Evernote (and other apps)
opportunities: Bring back some of the ideas of those early pioneers
Great tools for importing from Evernote (and other apps)
